# GetIPTVPanel

> UK-first reseller-panel enquiries, business-planning guidance and official-store player setup instructions.

## Primary routes

- / — UK B2B reseller overview
- /reseller-panel — proposed account-management workflow and capability checks
- /reseller-packages — owner-confirmed GBP base rates and pricing-request requirements
- /become-a-reseller — qualification guide and application
- /profit-calculator — transparent GBP operating estimate
- /individual-subscription — noindex service-scope route; no direct sales
- /is-iptv-legal-in-the-uk — noindex UK rights explainer pending qualified legal review
- /guides — supported setup guides

## Publication constraints

- No distribution-rights, package, price, uptime, user-count, review or income claim should be inferred unless it is visibly verified.
- The panel visual is a demonstration, not an exact product screenshot.
- Direct B2C sales and trials are disabled.
- Player applications do not include content or establish distribution rights.
- No ISP-block evasion, sideloading, unofficial APK or protected-service logo guidance is published.
